description: 通过该接口查询shein合作物流的预估运费，适用于全托管、shein自营模式；

children.name: x-lt-openKeyId
children.description: 访问用户隐私数据时的唯一权限标识 openKeyId

children.name: x-lt-timestamp
children.description: 请求时间戳，格式为时间转换为毫秒的值，也就是从1970年1月1日起至今的时间转换为毫秒，如：1583398764000

children.name: addressId
children.description: 发货地址id；从发货基本信息查询接口中获取；

children.name: agedProductCode
children.description: 时效产品编码；从物流产品查询接口获取；

children.name: expressInfoList
children.description: 查询物流公司信息；建议入参该时效产品下的所有物流公司；

children.name: companyCode
children.description: 物流公司编码；从物流产品查询接口companyCode字段获取；

children.name: isRecommend
children.description: 是否推荐物流公司；若物流公司是推荐物流的情况下必传；不传或乱传会影响费用的查询结果，但不会影响实际下单的费用）；

children.name: orderNoList
children.description: 订单号列表；全托管的场景该字段必填；

children.name: weight
children.description: 重量；单位kg，支持小数点后4位；取实物克重或抛重的最大值计算；

children.name: convertedEstimatedDeduction
children.description: 预估扣款，2位小数；预估运费=预估扣款（convertedEstimatedDeduction）-平台权益免扣金额（rightsExemptionAmount）；

children.name: failedList
children.description: 预估运费查询失败列表

requestExample: curl --location --request POST 'https://openapi.sheincorp.cn/open-api/idms/review-orders' \ --header 'x-lt-signature: <OFFICIAL_EXAMPLE_SIGNATURE>' \ --header 'x-lt-openKeyId: <OFFICIAL_EXAMPLE_OPEN_KEY_ID>' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8' \ --header 'x-lt-timestamp: 1753080399011' \ --data-raw '{ "agedProductCode": "SNV", "weight": "19.80", "orderType": 1, "addressId": 21189702, "orderNoList": [ "PB2506250000027" ], "expressInfoList": [ { "companyCode": "chemen", "isRecommend": true }, { "companyCode": "kuayue", "isRecommend": false }, { "companyCode": "TMS-anjun", "isRecommend": false }, { "companyCode": "EULOG", "isRecommend": false } ] }'
responseExample: code": "0", "msg": "OK", "info": { "successList": [], "failedList": [ { "code": "COSTESTIMATION0003", "companyCode": "chemen", "reason": "获取物流运费失败" }, { "code": "COSTESTIMATION0003", "companyCode": "kuayue", "reason": "获取物流运费失败" }, { "code": "COSTESTIMATION0003", "companyCode": "TMS-anjun", "reason": "获取物流运费失败" }, { "code": "COSTESTIMATION0003", "companyCode": "EULOG", "reason": "获取物流运费失败" } ] }, "traceId": "c2a98c0db5911d25" }
